title: OpenCode harness profile
description: Everything that changes when you change model. Plugins read this file and contain no model names of their own.

$comment.description: Free text for a human. Allowed here because every shipped profile carries one, and lanes.schema.json declares it too.

id.description: Slug used as the profile filename and the oc-harness use argument.

provider.description: opencode provider id, e.g. opencode, opencode-go, anthropic.

model.description: Model id without the provider prefix, e.g. beam-free.

family.description: Model family for grouping. Stealth models report null upstream, so this may be set by hand.

verified.description: ISO date a human checked this profile against live metadata.

retention.description: Must match an entry in retention.yml. A profile whose model is unknown there cannot become the default.

maxRetention.description: The worst retention a lane in this profile is allowed to resolve to. A lane walks its model chain and takes the first rung at or below this ceiling, so one profile can serve a fleet without sending a prompt to a provider that trains on it. Defaults to the profile's own retention.

limits.description: Token ceilings from the provider catalog. `input` is absent for several free models, in which case the loader derives it from `context`.

supports.description: Capability flags. Missing or false means do not emit the related config.

attachment.description: Accepts image or video input. Gates screenshot-based verification.

effort.description: Available reasoning levels, lowest to highest. Empty means the model has no tunable effort.

default.description: The level the session runs at by default. Null means the model has no tunable effort and no variant is emitted.

reserveShare.description: Share of the narrowest input ceiling in play held back for reasoning and tool output growth.

sessionTokens.description: Ceiling on the tokens one session may spend, prompt plus output. 0 turns the ceiling off. The guard warns at 70% and refuses every tool call at 100%.

roles.description: Requested effort per lane, never emitted raw. A lane listed here is enabled; a lane absent from here is not installed. It is resolved against the levels of the model the lane actually runs on, which is the profile's own effort.levels for a single-model profile and the lane model's levels for a fleet. `none` means reasoning off: a model that does not publish it gets no variant at all.

utility.description: The route opencode uses for its short auxiliary calls - a title, a one-line summary. Optional: a profile without one keeps the session model, which is what a single-model profile wants, because 'one route, and it is the one you asked for' is a promise those profiles make.

model.description: Model id without the provider prefix. Must be a model this profile already resolves to, so the utility route is never a model the fleet cannot run. The route itself does not change on failover; the profile keeps it.

why.description: The measurement that chose it. A route chosen by taste is a route that drifts.

roleModels.description: Model per lane. A lane absent from `roles` is not enabled. A lane absent from `roleModels` runs on the profile's base model.

prune.description: Deterministic context pruning. Only used when a model-driven compressor is unavailable or unproven.

keepRecentToolCalls.description: Verbatim tool outputs kept at the tail.

keepRecentTurns.description: Trailing turns whose text and reasoning stay verbatim.

keepUserMessages.description: Never stub anything inside a user message. Their instructions are the point of the session. This covers a tool result a user attached as well as their text: user text is kept either way, because prose is kept everywhere.

keepDistinctOutputs.description: Keep the newest copy of each DISTINCT tool output, however old it is. The recent-calls window is a window on recency, and a long session walks out of it: after six more tool calls the only copy of a file the agent read is gone, and the agent reads it again. The long-task A/B measured seventeen re-reads and five times the input tokens for the same answer.

keepDistinctBudgetChars.description: The character budget the distinct outputs have to fit in, newest first. The ones past the budget are stubbed like everything else. Null or unset means the profile's own context budget (pruneThreshold), which is what the pruner is measured against: without a ceiling the rule keeps every output the session has ever produced, and on a real 137-message session that was 4.74 MB of a 5.26 MB request against a 176,000 character budget. 0 keeps no distinct output at all.

fallback.description: Ordered profile ids to fall back to. Selection happens at session start, not mid-session: no opencode plugin hook can change a live session's model.

roleModel.description: A model for one lane, plus the effort levels that model actually offers, plus the ordered list of models that may serve the lane when the first one is spent or too private.

model.description: Model id without the provider prefix. Must resolve to a profile in this directory, so its limits and retention are known.

chain.description: Ordered models that may serve this lane, best first. The first rung the profile's maxRetention ceiling allows is the one that runs it, and the router walks the same chain when a route is spent.

oneOf.description: Desired level, resolved to the nearest available one.
This role should not set a variant at all.
